content.text:
**Finding: deviation (§ 12.1 License)** — high severity, redline validated and submitted.

- **Issue:** The grant is to "Customer" alone, expressly **"revocable"** with no breach/cure trigger, and silent on transfer. § 14.17 ("No other licenses or rights ... are granted") closes off any implied route for our Affiliates or contractors, and § 14.10 permits successor assignment of the Agreement but the licence itself is not stated to travel.
- **Fix:** Grant extended to Customer, its Affiliates (per the Preamble definition at p0015) and contractors acting on our behalf; "revocable" replaced with revocation only for our uncured material breach after notice; licence transferable to a successor by merger, consolidation or acquisition (mirroring § 14.10).
- **Fallback offered in the comment:** Affiliates covered on written notice to IBM, plus successor transfer.
